name: Opening Moves
tip: Drag a block to slide it. Push it into a gate of the same colour to send it out. It has to fit: the gate must be at least as wide as the block. Clear the box in as few moves as you can. Dragging the same block again still counts as one move.

name: Pillars
tip: Stone pillars and missing floor never move. Plan your routes around them.

name: Tramlines
tip: Striped blocks with arrows only slide one way: left/right or up/down. They can only leave through a gate in that direction.

name: Cold Start
tip: Frozen blocks can’t move. Every block that leaves the box chips the ice down by one. The number shows how many more exits it needs.

name: Onion
tip: Layered blocks: send one out through its outer colour and only the shell leaves. The core stays where it stopped and needs its own gate.

name: Turnstile
tip: Shifting gates change colour every time a block leaves. The dots show the order of colours.
